In plain English

It gathers the context for the task

The product combines your request with higher-priority instructions and useful conversation history. Files or saved memory may be added when available.

Picture thisA desk being prepared with the right brief, rules, and reference pages.

One level deeper

This workspace is called the AI context window

It is different from training. Training shaped the model's weights earlier; context is the information supplied for this specific task.

Common mythThe assistant does not automatically remember or search everything.

Reality check: This visual AI explainer is an educational high-level model, not a live trace or a claim that the three products have identical internals. Internal reasoning is represented as a task-level work plan, not private chain-of-thought.
